title: Digitized pitting-potential plot output
description: Strict schema for one digitized pitting-potential plot image. The artifact preserves classifier metadata and stores raw, non-normalized plotted values as self-contained series. It is intended both for production validation and for benchmarking LLM chart extraction.

paper_reference.description: Stable paper identifier copied from the paired plot-classification metadata. This is a string even when it contains only digits.

source_chart_manifest.description: Filename or stable identifier of the chart manifest from which the staged plot was selected.

plot_metadata.description: Classifier-produced context copied unchanged into the digitization artifact.

digitization_status.description: complete: every visible supported target series was extracted; partial: some reliable target data were extracted and omissions are noted; needs_review: no data emitted because interpretation is unresolved; skipped: no data emitted because the geometry is unsupported; unprocessed: preparation-template state only.

digitization_notes.description: Human-readable extraction notes. Required to be non-empty for partial, needs_review, and skipped outputs.

plot_data.description: Pitting-potential series extracted from the plot. Ancillary corrosion, repassivation, rate, fitted, or markerless series are excluded.

$comment: Semantic checks outside JSON Schema: series_id must be unique within plot_data; interval lower bounds must not exceed upper bounds; a numeric central value must lie within its interval; paper_reference, source_chart_manifest, and plot_metadata must exactly match the paired classifier artifact.

classifierAxis.description: High-level axis description supplied by the plot classifier.

label.description: Axis label as visible in the source plot.

unit.description: Unit as printed; use an empty string when no unit is shown.

chart_id.description: Stable chart identifier within the paper.

image_path.description: Path recorded by the classifier for the source chart image.

caption.description: Visible or extracted figure caption available to the digitizer.

reason_code.description: Classifier acceptance code required for digitization.

reason.description: Classifier explanation for accepting the chart.

relevant_panels.description: Visible panel labels containing target data; empty for a single-panel figure.

tag.description: Series-level context whose value is preserved exactly as visible, such as material, test solution, heat treatment, condition, method, marker, or unknown role.

axis.description: Series-specific axis definition. Axes are repeated per series to support multipanel and dual-axis figures without external references.

type.description: Allowed coordinate representation on this axis.

unit.description: Raw visible unit; empty when none is shown.

scale.description: Axis scale when it can be identified.

is_target.description: True only for the axis representing pitting potential. Exactly one axis in each series must be true.

point.description: One visible discrete point. x and y hold scalar central values. Experimental ranges or error bars use paired lower/upper fields; bounds are not digitization-confidence intervals.

x.description: Central x coordinate, category, or null for a range-only measurement.

y.description: Central y coordinate, category, or null for a range-only measurement.

x_lower.description: Visible lower endpoint of an experimental x interval.

x_upper.description: Visible upper endpoint of an experimental x interval.

y_lower.description: Visible lower endpoint of an experimental y interval.

y_upper.description: Visible upper endpoint of an experimental y interval.

label.description: Point-specific visible annotation only; omit when the point has no individual label.

series.description: One separable pitting-potential series. Connecting or fitted lines do not create additional points.

series_id.description: Concise identifier unique within this artifact.

panel.description: Visible panel label for multipanel figures; omit for a single-panel figure.

allOf.description: Exactly one axis must be the pitting-potential target.
